sources.title: A database of constructions of Hadamard matrices
Recent progress in the construction of Hadamard matrices
sources.version: 2026-11-03 v2; abstract 85 versus retrieved PDF/HTML 95 is unresolved
sources.status: version-discrepancy; independent verification reported, not locally replayed

known.statement: H(2^a) for every integer a >= 0 by Sylvester doubling
known.scope: classical existence family; literature theorem, not a new discovery

known.statement: H(q+1) for prime powers q congruent to 3 modulo 4
known.scope: prime-power domain and congruence are required

known.statement: H(2*(q+1)) for odd prime powers q congruent to 1 modulo 4
known.scope: prime-power domain and congruence are required
positive integer orders; construction closure does not imply all multiples of four
a barrier to a construction method, not nonexistence of Hadamard matrices

known.statement: Independent verification reported for the twelve formerly unresolved orders below 2000
known.scope: external literature report only; local matrices not downloaded or verified

obligations.statement: Prove that certified construction rules cover every positive order divisible by four
obligations.scope: unbounded symbolic coverage, not a finite scan

obligations.statement: A Legendre pair exists at every odd positive length
obligations.scope: sufficient route to Hadamard; no converse assumed

obligations.statement: A Legendre pair of odd length ell yields H(2*ell+2)
obligations.scope: known implication requiring a formal lifting proof in this project

obligations.statement: Supply parameters satisfying a proposed universal construction at all required indices
obligations.scope: cannot be inferred from conditional Gram identities
